{{file|DF/data/init/colors.txt}}

The '''colors.txt''' file defines the [[color scheme]] used by DF, in standard RGB color code.

== Default colors.txt ==
{{color scheme
|black=#000000
|dgray=#808080
|blue=#000080
|lblue=#0000ff
|green=#008000
|lgreen=#00ff00
|cyan=#008080
|lcyan=#00ffff
|red=#800000
|lred=#ff0000
|magenta=#800080
|lmagenta=#ff00ff
|brown=#808000
|yellow=#ffff00
|lgray=#c0c0c0
|white=#ffffff
}}
